name: Adj Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: ADJ Sheet Metal is a custom sheet metal fabrication and installation company serving Maryland, Virginia and DC metropolitan areas, as well as Baltimore and Richmond, since 2002. Based 30 miles south of Washington, DC, in White Plains, our company is over 250 industry veterans strong and our 45,000-square-foot manufacturing facility provides us with the space to tackle challenges of any range. about:
ADJ Sheet Metal was founded in 2002 in White Plains, Maryland, about 30 miles south of Washington, DC. The company began as a custom sheet metal fabrication and installation business serving the Maryland, Virginia, and DC metropolitan areas, including Baltimore and Richmond.

The firm operates two fully equipped fabrication shops totaling over 100,000 square feet — a 45,000‑square‑foot original facility and a 57,000‑square‑foot expansion added to meet growing demand. A workforce of more than 250 industry veterans runs highly automated equipment including CNC tables, lasers, water jets, a CNC plasma table, press brakes, shears, and machining tools. Core processes cover cutting (laser, water jet, plasma, shear), forming (press brake, rolling, stamping, punching, folding), and joining (welding, brazing, spot welding, riveting), along with machining and stretching. The company also provides estimating, BIM coordination using Trimble, design‑assist, and UL‑listed electrical box fabrication.

ADJ serves commercial construction contractors, federal government agencies, and mechanical and electrical trades across the Mid‑Atlantic. Typical projects include commercial special projects, design‑assist and tenant renovations, new construction, and federal building work in Maryland and the District of Columbia. The shop produces rectangular and spiral lock‑seam air ducts, custom HVAC cabinets, sheet metal fittings, and electrical enclosures for clients ranging from general contractors to federal facility managers.

The company states its mission is to provide a safe, productive workplace with the ultimate goal of delivering quality sheet metal products and installation while striving for industry leadership built on customer service, reliability, technology, innovation, and integrity.
